description: A living room sideboard vignette photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, showing a three-quarter view of a corner with the surface of a credenza as the primary plane. A warm amber pool of light radiates outward from the object and illuminates the walnut surface in a focused warm halo. To the right, a secondary credenza or nightstand in matching walnut with a glass top and visible drawer units provides a bookend. The mood is refined, modern, and quietly editorial.
